description: A system responsible for gathering patient consent decisions and filing them with a consent administration service. Typically implemented as an EHR system, patient portal, or similar application. Corresponds to the IHE-PCF Consent Recorder actor.
documentation: An application or product that implements the Consent Client System actor. Consent Client systems gather consent from patients and invoke the File Consent and Revoke Consent operations on a Consent Server System.
